name: taptime-app
description: TapTime — internal workforce & clinic operations app (mobile + desktop)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.ios:sync:dev: VITE_API_BASE=http://localhost:4180 vite build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO AD_HOC_CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=YES build
